units.label: Review channel
units.description: Select the joined Slack channel where the agent posts each sign-up review; the picker stores its stable channel ID.

units.label: Reviewer reply contains
units.description: Enter plain text that a reviewer reply must contain to reach the agent; leave blank so every reply reaches it.

units.label: Reviewers
units.description: Select the workspace members whose replies in a review thread the agent acts on; at least one reviewer is required.
